details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:141-142 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The PR adds `scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py` and references it from README.md line 385 and from agents.d/analysis-findings-p2-consumer-coverage.md, but it does not add the matching `## Scripts` entry in docs/INVENTORY.md.
  WHY: `tests/inventory_parity.py` in the `tests-release-and-log-analysis` job (run 42778109717, head c0adab47) fails with "docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py" plus the README.md:385 and agents.md:2012 reference failures, then exits 1, so the PR cannot go green (source severity BLOCKER; the other four reviewers raised this as a task gap, see CONSENSUS TASK GAPS).
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1545-1568 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the `report_structure_invalid` branch calls `handle_log_analysis_codex_failure` (handler at lines 1320-1333 exits, `exit 1` when codex_exit is 0), the step ends before the post-loop `--insert-data-gap` block at lines 1564-1568 runs.
  WHY: If the `workflow-log-output` artifact is missing (`wla_logs_missing="true"`) and every attempt fails the structure check, the held-back `workflow-log-analysis-report` artifact is uploaded without the "> Data gap: full workflow logs were unavailable for this run." line, which contradicts the agents and changelog fragments; reviewers disagreed on severity (MAJOR from gemini, minimax and glm; NIT from sonnet and luna), so the highest is used.
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:214-220 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `run_check()`, the `for repo in required:` loop exempts only `coverage.repositories_failed` repos and `errors[]` entries with scope `runs`, so a repo listed without error but with zero runs in the window still needs a `### ` subsection.
  WHY: scripts/analyze_workflow_logs.py builds `per_repo` only from runs (lines 418-447, `_aggregate_runs_by_key(runs, "repository")`), so the model has no data for an idle repo; every attempt then fails with `missing_repos=<idle repo>`, which leads to `report_structure_invalid`, a held-back report and the `ai:log-analysis-failed` label on full/weekly runs (all three rated this MAJOR).
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:211-220 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The per-repo match is a case-insensitive plain substring test (`needle in heading`), so a `### owner/app-two` heading counts as coverage for `owner/app`.
  WHY: When repos in `scope.repositories` share a prefix, a report that is missing one repo's subsection passes the check; reviewers disagreed on severity (MAJOR from minimax, NIT from luna), so the highest is used. Sonnet and glm raised the same issue under HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS only.
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:84-115 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_unfenced_lines`, `in_fence` toggles on every ``` line and is never reset when the input ends inside a fence, so an unclosed fence hides every later `## ` and `### ` heading.
  WHY: A model-produced report with an unbalanced fence is flagged as missing all 11 headings, and no diagnostic tells this apart from headings that are really missing; the retry repeats the same defect, so the report can stay held back (all three rated this NIT).
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:72-73 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_is_fence` recognises only backtick fences, not Markdown tilde fences (`~~~`).
  WHY: Headings inside a tilde-fenced block are counted as report structure even though they render as code, so the checker can accept a report that is missing visible sections (source severity NIT; sonnet raised the same point as a hardening suggestion).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md, `## Scripts` section, between line 140/141 (`scripts/check_integration_pr_readiness.py` / `scripts/check_resolver_diff.sh`) and line 142 (`scripts/check_workflow_script_refs.py`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk touches docs/INVENTORY.md; there is no `scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py` entry, although the script is referenced from README.md:385 and from the agents.d fragment that is folded into agents.md; CI job tests-release-and-log-analysis (run 42778109717, job 129701316027, head c0adab47) fails with "docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py", "README.md:385: references scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it" and "agents.md:2012: references ..." and exits 1 (all five rated this BLOCKER).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:141-142 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR adds `scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py`, referenced from README.md line 385 and agents.d/analysis-findings-p2-consumer-coverage.md, but adds no inventory line.
  WHY: `tests/inventory_parity.py` in tests-release-and-log-analysis (run 42778109717, head c0adab47) fails with three lines and exits 1. Fix: add one line after line 141, which is outside the plan grant but required for CI.
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:`run_check()` `for repo in required:` loop | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A repo listed without error but with no runs in the window is not exempt; `per_repo` is built only from runs (scripts/analyze_workflow_logs.py lines 418-447), and the collector's `coverage` (scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py lines 2477-2482) has no "no runs" category.
  WHY: Every attempt fails with `missing_repos=<idle repo>`, which leads to `report_structure_invalid` (workflow-log-analysis.yml line 1551), a held report, AI_PHASE_FAILURE_V1 and `ai:log-analysis-failed`. Fix: also exempt scoped repos that have no `runs[]` entry.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1545-1552, 1564-1568 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The handler exits (lines 1329-1330) before the post-loop `--insert-data-gap` block runs, so a held-back report never gets the data-gap line.
  WHY: The artifact uploaded at lines 1575-1583 lacks the data-gap line, which contradicts the agents fragment. Fix: call `--insert-data-gap` under the `wla_logs_missing` guard before line 1548.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "This PR must be production-safe on its own." plus the inventory contract enforced by `tests/inventory_parity.py`.
  Expected change site: docs/INVENTORY.md, `## Scripts`, between line 141 and line 142.
  Evidence of absence: No diff hunk touches docs/INVENTORY.md; tests-release-and-log-analysis fails on head c0adab47.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Note (not a gap): The title says "consumer coverage", but the plan's P2 (docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md line 473) is the structure check plus the log-gap line, which this PR delivers; the window marker belongs to P4.
- HARDENING: scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py `run_check()`: the substring match lets `### owner/app-two` cover `owner/app`. Fix: boundary regex (2 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py `_is_fence()`: `~~~` fences are not recognised. Fix: `startswith(("```", "~~~"))` (1 line).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
